content: Yakop itar tau pa ila ighita togha Esau
Laban ipul di ve ila, ve Yakop paam ipamundigin laghooŋ toni muul. Ilaagh ila le aŋela pida to Maaron tivot toni izi ataam luvuŋa.
Yakop ighita di, ve isaav ighaze: “Wai! Nene ndaaba to Maaron inadi to nepooŋ.” Tauto iwaat ndug tonowen iza Mahanaim.
Ghoro imbaaŋ tamtoghon pida ighaze tigham avo ve timuuŋ tila to togha Esau to inepneep izi taan suruvu to Seir. Taan tonowen iza ite Edom.
Ye ighur saveeŋ padi ighaze: “Yam ala avot to tiina tiou Esau, ghoro asaav pani aghaze: ‘Mbesooŋa tiom Yakop isaav tovene: Yesuru wagha Laban tikaria nepooŋ wa. Tauto aazne, ye ighaze imuul inim.
Ye le makau, esele, sipsip, mekmek, ve mbesooŋa nditamoot ve ndiliva katindi. Tovenen imbaaŋ ghei ninim pa nipaes payom, leso ughami toman lolom poia.’”

Yakop isavsaav padi le isob, ve tila tighita Esau. Tighita le isob, ghoro timuul tila to Yakop ve tipaes pani tighaze: “Yei nila nivot to togham, to nimuul ninim. Ve ulooŋ! Yesŋa tamtoghon toni 400 tilaghlaagh tinim tighaze tighita ghom.”
Yakop ilooŋ saveeŋ todi, le matughezaaŋ tiina ighami ve igham ŋgar naol. Tovenen ivalag tamtoghon toni toman ŋgai toni tinim rouŋ ru.
Pasa, mata iŋgal tovene: “Ighaze Esau inim ve ipamundigin malmal, ve irab rouŋ eez timaat, nene pale rouŋ ite irau tighau tila.”

Ghoro Yakop isuŋ pa Maaron ighaze: “O Yoova, yom Maaron to timbug Abaram ve tamaŋ Isak. Muuŋ, taum usaav payou ughaze namuul nala pa taan tiou ve naneep toman siŋ tiou. Ve usaav payou ughaze yom pale ugham poian ghou ve naneep pooi.

Maaron, you mbesooŋa tiom. Muuŋ, sawa to nambut ya Yordan ve nala, you leg mbeb eta maau. Nakis titi moghon ve nalaagh. Eemoghon yom lolom ineep tiou, ve ugham poian ghou kat itaghon saveeŋ mbuaaŋ tiom. Tauto aazne, namuul nanim toman rouŋ tintina ru tonene. You poiag irau to ugham ŋgar tovene payou maau.
O Maaron, you naghason ghom. Ugham mulin ghou ila toghag Esau nima. Pasa, you namatughez pani kat. Pale inim ve ipamundigin malmal payou toman ndizwag ve ndinatug, ve irab ghei nisob nimatmaat.
Maaron, matam iŋgal saveeŋ to umbua toman ghou. Yom usaav payou ughaze pale ugham poian ghou, ve ugham papaghu tiou timasa tinim naol le irau tinin di maau tinimale magargaar to te.” Mbnp 28:13-15
Yakop isuŋ le isob, ve ineep tonowe pa mboŋ. Mboŋmaagh ghoro, ivureer ŋgai pida tila saguan ighaze ighur di timuuŋ tila to togha Esau.
Ŋgai tovene: Mekmek paŋgaar 200 ve nditamoot tamoot ee (20). Sipsip paŋgaar 200 ve nditamoot tamoot ee (20).
Kamel paŋgaar tamoot ee saaŋgul (30) toman ndinatudi. Makau paŋgaar tamoot ru (40), ve nditamoot saaŋgul (10). Ve esele paŋgaar tamoot ee (20) ve nditamoot saaŋgul (10).
Yakop ighur ŋgai tonowen tila ketooŋ ketooŋ, ve ighur di tila mbesooŋa toni pida nimadi, ve isaav padi ighaze: “Yam amuuŋ. Eemoghon alup gham pa laghooŋ malep. Alaagh saguan saguan pa taumim.”
Ve Yakop isaav ariaŋa pa mbesooŋa to ilaagh imuuŋ tovene: “Ighaze toghag Esau inim ivot tiom, ve ighason ghom ighaze: ‘Yom mbesooŋa to sei? Ve ula sine? Ve ŋgai ketooŋ tonanan to sei?’
Ighaze ye ighason ghom tovene, ghoro upamuul aliŋa ughaze: ‘Ŋgai tonene, to mbesooŋa tiom Yakop. Ye ighaze igham di sorok pa tiina toni Esau. Ye tau ilaghlaagh muri.’”

Yakop igham saveeŋ raraate pa mbesooŋa toni to inim ru, ve ite to inim tol, ve mbesooŋa toni tisob to matadi pa ŋgai ketooŋadi tonenen, ve tigham di tila. Ve isaav padi tovene: “Yam ala avot to toghag Esau, ghoro asavia saveeŋ raraate moghon pani.

Ve asaav pani aghaze: ‘Olman, mbesooŋa tiom Yakop ilaghlaagh muri.’” Yakop igham tovene pasa, mata iŋgal ighaze: “You pale nagham mbeb naol tonene timuuŋ tila toni sorok. Leso nagharaat lolo, ve sawa to nala peria toni, ye pale lolo poia payou.”
Tovenen mbeb naol to Yakop ighaze igham pa togha, ye ighur di timuuŋ tila. Eemoghon ye tau ineep izi ndug tonenen pa mboŋ.
Yakop yesuru Maaron titoov tapiridi
Mboŋ ee moghon tonenen, Yakop imundig, ve igham ndizuwa ru toman ziria ru paam to mbesooŋa toni, ve ndinatu saaŋgul ve eez. Tila titaghon maghat to ya Yabok ve tivool tila pa paŋa ite.

Ye ila ighur di tizi, ve imuul ila isaav pa mbesooŋa toni tiyou mburuguuŋ toni pida, ve titaghon di tivool tila. Ve ye eŋgeni ineep tonowe pa mboŋ. Inepneep, ve ŋgeu eez inim ve yesuru Yakop titoov tapiridi izi tonowe le ndugizau.
Ŋgeu tonowen ighita ighaze tapiri irau to ilib pa Yakop maau. Tovenen irab Yakop ŋgoi le seŋgaŋa ipas.
Ghoro isaav pani ighaze: “Upul ghou nala! Paam ndugizau.” Eemoghon Yakop isaav pani ighaze: “Maau. You pale nakiskis ghom tovene le irau ughur palotiiŋ iza tiou, ghoro napul ghom ula.”
Tovenen ŋgeu tonenen ighasoni ighaze: “Izam sei?” Yakop ipamuul aliŋa ighaze: “You izag Yakop.”
Ŋgeu tonenen isaav pani muul ighaze: “Pale tiwaat izam Yakop muul maau. Pale tiwaat ghom Israel. Pasa, yamru Maaron ve tamtoghon atoov tapirimim le ulib padi wa.”
Mbnp 35:10
Ghoro Yakop ighason ŋgeu tonenen ighaze: “Izam sei?” Ŋgeu tonenen ipamuul aliŋa ighaze: “Pughu vena to ughason ghou pa izag?” Ghoro ighur palotiiŋ iza to Yakop, ve ipuli ve ila.
Yakop imundig ve isaav ighaze: “Aazne, you naghita Maaron nagho pa matag, eemoghon namaat maau.” Tovenen iwaat ndug tonowen iza Peniel.
Ndag iza peria, ve Yakop ipul ndug Peniel, ve ilaagh. Iweuweu aghe ve ila. Pasa, ŋgoi seŋgaŋa ipas.
Pughu tonene, to muuŋ ve inim aazne, yes Israela irau tighan ŋgai minda to ipaak ila tua to ŋgoi ne maau. Pasa, ŋgeu tonowen irab Yakop ŋgoi le ipas.

footnotes.text: Pisis Yakop pughu tovene: ‘kaarom,’ ma ‘aghe gudu.’ Ve iza paghu Israel, pughu tovene: “Yesuru Maaron titoov tapiridi.”
